item.title: Pressure on global chokepoints drives Asia's increased use of Arctic Trade Routes
item.description: Asian nations began pilot voyages over a decade ago to find routes to Europe and the Middle East that were faster and less vulnerable to chokepoints. The ongoing war has added impetus to those efforts.

item.title: With invite to join EU bloc, Canada's prime minister speaks to European Parliament

item.description: The European Union backs Canada's bid to become the bloc's first "associate member," as Brussels seeks closer ties with Ottawa and Trump calls the idea "laughable."

item.title: How Jared Kushner is mixing U.S. diplomacy with his billion-dollar business
item.description: The New Yorker's Dexter Filkins says while Trump's son-in-law is a U.S. special envoy negotiating peace, he's also working on private business deals, raising billions in some of the same countries.

item.title: Russia seizes Ukrainian POWs, then it demands favors from their relatives
item.description: Russia is believed to be holding thousands of Ukrainian POWs. Russia is also tormenting the families of these prisoners by contacting their relatives on social media and demanding they help Russia.

item.title: EU's Ursula von der Leyen says she wants Canada to become an associate member
item.description: European Commission President Ursula von der Leyen on Wednesday proposed making Canada the European Union's first associate member, a striking overture as U.S. President Donald Trump's tariffs drive Ottawa closer to Europe.
